jobs.title: IT Project Management Intern at CSUN 10052 - Information Technology
jobs.description: Employer: CSUN 10052 - Information Technology Expires: 10/17/2026 IT Project Management Intern California State University, Northridge – Division of Information Technology, Project Management Department: IT Governance and EngagementReports to: Celene Valenzuela (Assistant Director of Governance and Engagement) Duration: Fall 2026 Semester (18 weeks)Work Hours: Up to 20 hours/week Position OverviewWithin the Division of Information Technology, as a member of the IT Project Management Office (IT PMO), the intern will gain hands-on experience applying enterprise systems and project management concepts to active technology projects that support CSUN’s students, faculty, and staff. The IT PMO uses a common framework for how IT projects—small, intermediate, and large—are proposed, planned, executed, controlled, and closed, including shared tools, templates, and governance processes. Under the guidance of the Assistant Director and working closely with the Project Manager leading the ServiceNow enterprise platform (and related systems), the intern will support project leads from initial intake and deep-dive planning meetings through project completion, helping to organize work, track progress, and document outcomes. This internship is designed to reinforce project organization and staffing, planning and scheduling (PERT/CPM concepts), control, budgeting awareness, quality, and project environments across campus units—while giving the student direct exposure to major enterprise IT initiatives in a structured PMO environment. The intern will also observe and use current enterprise and project management tools in practice. Key Responsibilities IT PMO Framework, Enterprise Systems, & Deep Dive SupportParticipate in IT PMO deep dive sessions where the project sponsor and assigned project leads review the project’s purpose, goals, scope, key team members, major milestones, assumptions, and potential risks using the IT PMO project playbook.Observe how projects of different sizes (small enhancements, intermediate rollouts, and large implementations) are evaluated for strategic alignment, feasibility, cost–benefit, risk, dependencies, and governance review within an enterprise systems context (e.g., ServiceNow and other campus platforms).Capture and organize meeting notes, decisions, risks, and action items from deep dive and other planning meetings; ensure that project playbooks and related artifacts are documented and stored in the IT PMO repository. Project Organization, Planning, Scheduling (PERT/CPM Concepts), and ControlWork with an IT Project Manager to build and maintain project schedules, reinforcing concepts such as task sequencing, dependencies, and critical paths, and supporting the Project Manager throughout the project lifecycle.Help identify and document roles and responsibilities for project team members, reflecting project organization and staffing principles.Monitor progress against the plan and follow up with team members on upcoming deadlines and deliverables, contributing to schedule and scope control. Governance, Budget Awareness, and Quality SupportAssist the Assistant Director in preparing updates for IT Leadership and CSUN Technology Governance, including materials for monthly IT Leadership PMO project portfolio updates where progress is reviewed and roadblocks are surfaced for support.Develop a basic understanding of how budget, effort, and resource constraints influence project decisions, timelines, and prioritization (no direct budget authority, but exposure to how these factors are considered).Support quality-focused activities such as tracking issues, documenting acceptance criteria, and helping summarize key quality and performance outcomes after major releases. Project Environments and ReportingContribute to the preparation of concise project status updates for IT Leadership and governance bodies, learning how to tailor information to different stakeholders and escalation paths. Project Close-Out, Metrics, Hypercare, and DocumentationSupport the PMO and project leads in formal project close-out, including documenting outcomes versus goals, collecting basic usage/impact metrics, and capturing key lessons learned.Help monitor the Hypercare period (typically 2–4 weeks after launch), track issues and enhancement requests for enterprise systems, and confirm that key items are resolved or transitioned into ongoing support processes.Help organize and archive project documentation (charters, schedules, status reports, close-out summaries, and lessons learned) in the central SharePoint location for future reference and reuse on subsequent projects. Important NotesThis is an unpaid internship for educational purposes only.

jobs.description: Employer: CSUN 10349 - Student Affairs IT - Student Affairs Expires: 12/02/2026 Student Affairs IT is looking for a motivated student assistant with web development skills and a desire to work in a real-world web application development environment. Our team has over 40 years of combined Fortune 50 and consulting experience in the web space...you'll learn a lot here.
